It is not a dead end: the GitHub MCP tool GITHUB_COMMIT_MULTIPLE_FILES (owner kavopdf, repo app, branch main, upserts=[{path,content,encoding:utf-8}]) commits several files atomically and worked for all four commits of this run. The next run should commit that way, then 'git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main' so HEAD matches origin, then chain.py. chain.py's sync check is strict SHA equality and also refuses a dirty tree, and it rewrites CHAIN.json - so commit CHAIN.json again after each chain.py run.

context: THREE BUILDS, THE MECHANISM IS NOW BOUNDED AND ITS FAILURE MODE IS LOCATED: THE WIDTH. Build 1 (Helvetica advances everywhere, inset-overflow correction, row = max(declared, lines x rowLineTw) in w:trHeight atLeast, charged before writtenRowsTw): 42 of 213 documents change, 0 docx page-break moves, and price-list-right-aligned-amounts goes 1.79 -> 81.15 with 1 -> 2 pages. Build 2 (4 % tolerance for the Helvetica/DejaVu gap): 41 of 213; the price list drops 38 -> 16 changed rows but every one still reads 312 -> 440 tw, exactly 2 x its 220 tw row line, so the excess is structural and not metric drift. Build 3 came from READING ROW 0 of that table instead of rebuilding blind: its cells are Times New Roman (digits 0.500 em) and Courier New, and the charge was measuring Helvetica (0.556 em, 11 % wide) - so advanceEm now picks TIMES/COURIER/HELVETICA from the cell's own face. That build is the right shape: 12 of 213 documents change and on 041122 exactly ONE row moves, row 77, 2220 -> 3000 tw, which IS the instruction cell the handoff describes. It still must not be kept: measured, price-list-right-aligned-amounts 1.79 -> 32.54 and 77_arabic_rtl_document 17.14 -> 58.55. THE DIAGNOSIS: w:ind is written from insetTw AFTER the textOverflows correction, so the renderer is handed a width the text fits; a charge computed against anything narrower invents a wrap the renderer never draws, and each invented line is 3.5 pt of drift down the table (16 rows x 3.5 = the 56 pt that lands the figures 56 pt out). THE NEXT MOVE IS ONE LINE OF ARITHMETIC, not a fourth build: charge against (emitted w:tcW - emitted w:ind) from the same <w:tc>, and only beyond the row's own slack. On the price list that width is the drawn text + 20 tw, so the charge is 1 line and the document is untouched; on 041122 it still fires on the 9-paragraph cell. All three patches are committed: patches/wrap-charge-helvetica.patch (apply with git apply --include='*DocxWriter.java', it carries state-file hunks too), patches/wrap-charge-gated-1.04.patch, patches/wrap-charge-face-aware.patch. Engine at HEAD, nothing carried. OPERATIONAL, paid for this run: the whole corpus converts in 81-90 s in one JVM (ConvertAll, 213 files, 0 failed) so a corpus diff is two calls; p2w.measure_doc is 25-60 s a document, so measure the top movers only - never the whole changed set; scipy must be pip-installed every run; 041122's charged builds will not render inside a 280 s soffice call.
